_how: DLC-320 same-item pass over the 2026-11-18 Google Shopping cards, Amazon listings and ChatGPT-named sellers. asin: listing title read (brand, model, the unit alone, new). drop: merchants whose card for this product is another model, a bundle, a non-US listing, a deal blog (PzDeals posts deals, it sells nothing) or an unknown shop under 60% of the store's price. beaten: a same-item seller named in that day's ChatGPT answer that the matcher could not see.
